title: Price list (GET {base}/v1/prices)
description: A server's model prices, in the format of docs/price-endpoint.md. Every rate is per million tokens in the list's currency, except per_request, which is per request. An absent or null rate is unknown, 0 is free.

unit.description: "<currency> per 1M tokens". A client ignores a response whose unit it doesn't recognise.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code or a short label. Overrides the currency in unit. Default USD.

fetched_at.description: When the server computed these prices.

valid_until.description: Until when a client may use these prices without asking again.

rate.description: Per million tokens. Absent or null: unknown. Negative, non-finite or above 1e9: unknown for that entry.

cacheWrite.description: One rate for every cache lifetime, or rates by lifetime: "5m", "1h", or any "<n>s", "<n>m", "<n>h".

reasoning.description: Reasoning tokens, when they differ from output.

per_request.description: A flat price per request, in the list's currency (not per million tokens).

tier.description: Total input (uncached + cache read + cache write) above input_above bills the whole request at the tier's rates; a rate missing from a tier keeps the base rate.

route.description: Where the server may send the model, and what that costs. Informational unless the server reports which route served a request.

id.description: The same id /v1/models returns and a client sends as model.

available.description: false: the server won't serve the model now.
